Maeve: Heads-up: support reported tenant `northstar` sees the console badge as v2 but billing shows v1 invoices.
Rohan: That's because console reads feature flags; billing reads routerbilling tag. mismatch is expected for 'preview' mode but we need clearer signals.
Sam: Can we avoid ambiguous language? suggestion: rename badge to 'Admin preview: v2' and show a tiny 'billing: v1' pill when they differ.
Ivy: Telemetry problem: analytics can't join flag -> routing easily. we only capture client_version. need disp_ver (flag) + obs_ver (handshake) in logs.
Rohan: Agreed. Also add router header X-Billed-Version for downstream systems. billing should never read console flags.
Maeve: Security: any token-derived fingerprint must be irreversible. propose HMAC-SHA256 trunc12 using KMS key.
Sam: Sampling: collect joint records at 1% global, 5% for tenants in active rollouts. derive metric tenant_display_mismatch_pct.
ops-bot: Note: telemetry schema change must go through analytics migration window. See PLAT-1510.
Ivy: UX change: add tooltip: 'Admin preview indicates UI setting; live traffic may differ.' ask legal for sign-off.
Rohan: I'll draft an RFC for 'display-only' rollout mode: UI flips but billing/stats are unchanged. includes examples and rollback guidelines.
Maeve: Action items: 1) telemetry fields (Ivy) 2) router header + billing read fix (Rohan) 3) HMAC helper + security review (Sam + eng-security) 4) console copy + legal (Maeve) 5) sampling+alerts (ops)
ConsoleBot: Task created PLAT-1511 assigned to Maeve.
Rohan: Will coordinate a canary deploy once telemetry PR lands so we can verify joins.
Maeve: Thanks all. I'll post a short support FAQ blurb to avoid more tickets.
